executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();parent=root/"reports/research/510300_bank_demand_native_calendar_same_quarter_history_v1/next_experiment.json"
proposal=json.loads(parent.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert sha(parent.read_bytes())=="091c6a5b64905a5ce58eb8303fabf12b320176b77a4fc501205da911bea80e3d"
for key in ["parent_result","read_only_candidate_date_metadata"]:
 x=proposal[key];assert sha((root/x["path"]).read_bytes())==x["sha256"]
out=root/"reports/research/510300_post_frozen_2026_historical_joint_sample_source_admission_v1";out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def save(name,x):
 p=out/name
 if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("已登记，禁止重复："+rel(p))
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
 return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args],encoding="utf-8").strip()
at=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
protocol=dict(proposal)
protocol.update({"experiment_id":"E120","registered_at":at,"status":"REGISTERED_BEFORE_GLOBAL_PRIOR_USE_AND_TRAINING_SOURCE_ADMISSION",
 "parent_proposal":{"path":rel(parent),"sha256":sha(parent.read_bytes())},
 "prior_read_boundary":"已经只读E119日期元数据、R58旧裁决及原期限模型协议设定至2026-09-24；只凭旧E100截至2025-12-31不能认证当前项目未使用2026。尚未对原156逐日与旧实际预测/执行日期比较、未读新收益。",
 "fixed_local_prior_use_evidence_routes":[
 "reports/research/510300_loan_maturity_composition_daily_v1",
 "reports/research/510300_banker_loan_approval_daily_v1",
 "reports/research/510300_confirmed_structure_study_v1",
 "reports/research/510300_industrial_joint_nonlinear_score_v1",
 "reports/data_quality/510300_daily_quality.json"],
 "local_lookup_contract":"先列上述少数指定目录顶层文件及固定元数据，原预测/账户决策的日期列/使用字段/原source refs读取；不读原156新股票收益，不从其他分支挑性能或改其源码/状态。",
 "novelty_contract":"分别记录原E100外日期、其他宏观实际金融已用日期、其他线已用日期和原信息已用。只跨单个模型样本边界不能当项目独立新样本；源/定义差异只有具体现有证据成立才能认证。",
 "training_support_contract":"原冻结金融树504/至少252及原成熟池门不因候选只有156日期而降低；新金融形式未登记、训练/成熟支持未建立，不用原缺量钟的旧44拼接、重训或放宽门救援。",
 "conditional_collection_decision":"在全项目已用记录和必要支持核对后，若新增样本/实质原信息与训练成熟资格仍未成立，本固定候选不发23宏观GET或主价GET，保存未知/拒绝并结束；不宣称23原稿不存在、不营救其他已关闭路线。",
 "expected_deliverable":"原156逐日的旧实际金融使用身份与原23对象的已有/未证状态、主价当前收据证明差异、必要训练门和来源取得条件裁决；不生成预测或股票标签。",
 "previous_goal_turn":"PROGRESS_E119_ACTUAL_SAME_CALENDAR_JOINT_FINDINGS_AND_ROUTE_DISTINCT_HISTORY_ADMISSION",
 "root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0})
pref=save("protocol.json",protocol)
save("运行前git记录_E120.json",{"at":at,"branch":git("branch","--show-current"),"HEAD":git("rev-parse","HEAD"),
 "tracked_status":git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no"),"existing_source_code_edits":0})
save("原156全项目使用与历史信息准入认领_E120.json",{"at":at,"protocol":pref,
 "candidate_date_count":156,"candidate_window":proposal["candidate_calendar_start"]+"至"+proposal["candidate_calendar_end"],
 "registered_before_global_actual_date_use_comparison":True,"conditional_GET_not_sent":True,
 "new_financial_budget_all_zero":True,"goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False})
print(json.dumps({"E120":"实际事前登记","协议":pref,"先核全项目真实使用与必要支持":True,
 "目前采集/金融执行":0,"原窗口156日期不变":True},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
